audit_result.proof_trace: `liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens` (L1045-1046) calls `get_spot_price` for both the debt and collateral prices — raw spot with staleness check only, zero EMA-spot deviation guard — to compute how much collateral to seize. The non-liquidation path enforces `get_price_with_check` (EMA + deviation assert) but liquidation bypasses it entirely, making seize amounts directly proportional to manipulable spot prices.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An attacker uses an external flash loan to manipulate the DEX spot price of the debt token upward (or collateral token downward), then calls `liquidate` on an undercollateralized position; `liquidate_calculate_seize_ctokens` computes the seize ratio from the manipulated spot prices, granting the attacker excess collateral per unit repaid, from which the attacker repays the flash loan and pockets the surplus.

PROP-current-fina-pre-004.text: Oracle price must pass EMA vs spot deviation check before use in collateral or debt valuation.
PROP-current-fina-pre-004.assertion: forall use_price(asset): abs(price_ema - price_spot) / price_ema <= ema_tolerance
